description: This file contains functions for analyzing behavioral observation data, including Cohen's Kappa and Needleman-Wunsch similarity calculations between observations, with database interactions and GUI prompts.

methods.name: subj_behav_modif
methods.description: Retrieves current behaviors for a specific observation, subject, and time, optionally including modifiers, from the database.

methods.name: cohen_kappa
methods.description: Calculates Cohen's Kappa coefficient for inter-rater reliability between two observations over a specified interval.

methods.name: irr_cohen_kappa
methods.description: Performs Cohen's Kappa analysis across multiple observations, with GUI prompts for user input.

methods.name: needleman_wunsch_identity
methods.description: Computes the Needleman-Wunsch similarity (identity score) between two observations based on behavioral sequences.

methods.name: needleman_wunsch
methods.description: Calculates the Needleman-Wunsch similarity for multiple observations, with GUI prompts for user input.
